text:
Maya R: Ok I finally did the thing — moved my desk under the skylight and attached a small plant shelf above the monitors :sun_with_face: https://files.redwood.example/snapshots/2413007654-sky-desk.jpg
Derek: whoa that looks great. How's the wifi under a skylight though? :thinking_face:
Maya R: so far fine but had one weird dropout during standup. suspecting the router location + metal blinds reflection?
Sophia: fun fact: glass + shortwave = weird multipath. try moving the router off the floor and angle the antenna away from the window if it's external.
Maya R: router is in a crate under the shelf atm. gonna try mounting it higher. anyone have a tidy wall-mount trick?
Raj: I zip-tied a tiny velcro strip and stuck a 3M hook behind my monitor. works for AC adapters too.
Derek: if you want a quick test run a continuous ping: `ping 8.8.8.8 -c 100` and check for drops, then test after moving.
Maya R: ran it — 2 drops out of 100. moved router to shelf (10cm higher) and re-ran: 0 drops :party_parrot:
Leo: nice! also pro-tip: enable 5GHz band only for your laptop SSID to avoid band-steering chaos.
Maya R: ok doing that. thanks team. quick poll — keep the plant up there or will I be cursed with leaves on keyboard forever? :herb::keyboard:
Sophia: keep it. your camera looks so much nicer for calls. :thumbsup:
Derek: keep it but put a tray underneath for rogue soil :laughing:
ops-bot: image uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/uploads/2413007899-router-shelf-move.jpg
Maya R: added a tiny tray and tested for 30 mins — stable. thanks all. anyone want my leftover IKEA plant hook? free pickup in SF. :package:
